title: Easy Melted Russian Butter Pilaf
description: A buttery, aerated Russian dish featuring melted butter and papillote, perfect for a hangover cure, this diabetic-friendly recipe is a great option for a comforting meal. It is made with simple ingredients and is easy to prepare.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the rice to the saucepan and stir to coat the rice with the butter and mix with the onion and garlic.
Add the chicken broth, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Cover the saucepan with a piece of parchment paper, creating a papillote, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is cooked.
Remove the saucepan from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley on top.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
